instructions: Tear one page from the notebook then tear off the spiral edge so the sheet is an even rectangle.
Fold the sheet vertically in half bringing the long edges together and crease with the fold on top.
Fold the top right and top left corners inward to the center crease to form two triangles.
Fold each slanted top edge inward again to the center line to form a sharper point.
Fold the whole shape in half along the center crease with the pointed folds on the outside.
Fold each outer slanted edge down to the bottom center fold to create a wing on both sides.
Hold the bottom keel of the airplane and throw it forward to fly it.
